cardEffects: [Main] By returning 9 levels' total worth of Digimon cards from your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck, you may play 1 [Ghost] trait Digimon card of each returned card's level from your trash without paying the costs. Then, the Digimon this effect played gain ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT20-098 (2025/01/24, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No, you cannot. The [By] condition cannot be performed only in part. For the [Main] effect of this card, it must be returned to the bottom of the deck for the specified Lv. total.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to return cards in my opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck so that their Lv. total is 8 or less?

rulings.answer: Digimon cards of Lv.3 and Lv.6 can be played. You can play one Digimon card of the same Lv. as the returned card.
rulings.question: If the [Main] effect of this card returns Lv.3 and Lv.6 Digimon cards from the opponent's Trash to the deck, which Lv. Digimon card can I play from my Trash?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can play. You can play one card of the same Lv. as the card you returned.
rulings.question: If the [Main] effect of this card returns 3 Lv.3 Digimon cards from the opponent's trash to the deck, can I play 3 Lv.3 Digimon cards from my trash?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Ghost] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
